sources.title: Machine tool calibration: measurement, modeling and compensation
sources.titleEn: Machine tool calibration: measurement, modeling and compensation
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 五軸工具機運動學校準
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩套明確標籤的預算表與驗收依據。；若要求絕對誤差≤15 μm，23 μm 最壞和不通過，即使 RSS 小於 15 μm。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver two explicitly labeled budgets and acceptance rationale.; For an absolute error limit of 15 μm, the 23 μm bound fails even though RSS is smaller.
related.difference: 由旋轉軸角度誤差推算遠端位置誤差，理解阿貝偏置。
related.differenceEn: Convert rotary angular error into remote position error and understand Abbe offset.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 上界最壞和 B=Σbi；獨立零均值標準差 σ=sqrt(Σσi²)，兩者意義不同。；教學三個誤差量為 10、8、5 μm，分別以界限與標準差兩種假設計算。；最壞和=23 μm；若為獨立標準差，RSS=sqrt(100+64+25)=13.7477 μm。
橫向誤差 e=L sinδθ，小角度可近似 Lδθ，但 δθ 必須用弧度。；教學 L=200 mm，δθ=0.010°。；e=200 sin(0.010°)=0.0349066 mm；弧度近似為 200×0.000174533。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Worst-case bound B=Σbi differs from independent zero-mean σ=sqrt(Σσi²).; Teaching terms are 10, 8 and 5 μm, considered under two separate assumptions: bounds or standard deviations.; Worst-case sum=23 μm; if independent standard deviations, RSS=sqrt(189)=13.7477 μm.
Transverse error e=L sinδθ≈Lδθ for small angles, with δθ in radians.; Teaching L=200 mm and δθ=0.010°.; e=200 sin(0.010°)=0.0349066 mm; the radian approximation is 200×0.000174533.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 車削工件夾持工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付兩套明確標籤的預算表與驗收依據。；若要求絕對誤差≤15 μm，23 μm 最壞和不通過，即使 RSS 小於 15 μm。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver two explicitly labeled budgets and acceptance rationale.; For an absolute error limit of 15 μm, the 23 μm bound fails even though RSS is smaller.
related.difference: 用摩擦力矩模型檢查夾持概念，區分防滑與工件變形。
related.differenceEn: Check a clamping concept with friction torque while separating slip resistance from deformation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 上界最壞和 B=Σbi；獨立零均值標準差 σ=sqrt(Σσi²)，兩者意義不同。；教學三個誤差量為 10、8、5 μm，分別以界限與標準差兩種假設計算。；最壞和=23 μm；若為獨立標準差，RSS=sqrt(100+64+25)=13.7477 μm。
理想可抵抗力矩 M=μNtotal r；接觸力相加但不可重複計入每爪。；教學 μ=0.20、Ntotal=300 N、r=0.020 m；外加力矩 0.60 N·m。；M=0.20×300×0.020=1.20 N·m，靜態比值為 2。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Worst-case bound B=Σbi differs from independent zero-mean σ=sqrt(Σσi²).; Teaching terms are 10, 8 and 5 μm, considered under two separate assumptions: bounds or standard deviations.; Worst-case sum=23 μm; if independent standard deviations, RSS=sqrt(189)=13.7477 μm.

Ideal resisting torque M=μNtotal r; sum contact forces without counting each jaw twice.; Teaching μ=0.20, Ntotal=300 N, r=0.020 m and external torque 0.60 N·m.; M=0.20×300×0.020=1.20 N·m, a static ratio of two.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
